comparisons.reason: Item 0 only counts comments pointing to an internal logical contradiction or inconsistency among the OP's own stated premises or conclusion. Item 1 counts any explicit challenge to an underlying stated or unstated assumption or premise, which is much broader. Challenging an assumption without claiming a contradiction would be 1 for item 1 and 0 for item 0. The null and empty rules are similar, but the core constructs differ: a narrow subtype versus a broad construct.
